quality_bar: Worthwhile means I come away understanding, knowing or appreciating something I didn't before. Prefer depth over hype: explanations, analysis, craft, real expertise, full performances. Prefer independent and niche creators over mass-market channels. Humour is fine if it's clever. Hide ragebait, drama and gossip, reaction videos, clickbait titles that overpromise, AI-generated slop, hustle/motivation/get-rich content, generic top-10 lists, and mainstream hype.
